description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointing Mr. Sumith Abeysinghe Secretary to the Cabinet as Acting Secretary to the President w.e.f. 15.02.2015
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. Sumith Abeysinghe) to a government position (Acting Secretary to the President). It does not include any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or duties associated with the position, focusing solely on the personnel change. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
